name: Philips Hue
description: This plugin enables native integration with Philips Hue bridges in Jellyfin 12+ (CLIP API v2). It features multi-profile automations filtered by users, devices, and media types with smooth cinema fades on play, comfortable ambient dimming on pause, and previous state restoration on stop.
overview: Synchronize Philips Hue smart lighting with Jellyfin playback states across custom profiles.
